properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.client.simple.enable
properties.description: enable simple (private HMAC signed) mcp client support.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.client.simple.instances
properties.description: simple mcp client instances, a McpToolProvider bean is registered for each instance with non-blank name.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.client.simple.instances[].enable
properties.description: enable this instance, skipped when false.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.client.simple.instances[].name
properties.description: instance name, also used as the registered bean name, instance is skipped when blank.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.client.simple.instances[].description
properties.description: instance description for mcp tool provider.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.client.simple.instances[].base-url
properties.description: server base url, e.g. http://localhost:8811/ .

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.client.simple.instances[].app-id
properties.description: caller app id (header X-App-Id).

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.client.simple.instances[].app-key
properties.description: caller app key used to compute HMAC sign.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.client.simple.instances[].hmac-name
properties.description: HMAC algorithm name for app sign.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.client.stream.official.v2024.enable
properties.description: enable official 2024 stream mcp client auto configuration.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.client.official.v2024.stream.instances
properties.description: official 2024 stream mcp client instances.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.client.official.v2024.stream.instances[].enable
properties.description: enable this instance, skipped when false.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.client.official.v2024.stream.instances[].initial
properties.description: eagerly initialize the client (initialize handshake) instead of lazy connect.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.client.official.v2024.stream.instances[].name
properties.description: instance name, also used as the registered bean name, instance is skipped when blank.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.client.official.v2024.stream.instances[].description
properties.description: instance description for mcp tool provider.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.client.official.v2024.stream.instances[].url
properties.description: streamable http mcp endpoint url, e.g. http://localhost:9999/v2024/mcp .

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.client.official.v2024.stream.instances[].bearer-token
properties.description: Authorization bearer token sent to the server.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.client.official.v2024.stream.instances[].headers
properties.description: extra http headers sent with every request.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.client.official.v2024.stream.instances[].tag-rules
properties.description: tag rules applied to tools of this instance.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.client.official.v2024.stream.instances[].tag-rules[].pattern
properties.description: ANT style tool name pattern of the tag rule.

properties.name: i2f.springboot.ai.mcp.client.official.v2024.stream.instances[].tag-rules[].tags
properties.description: tags added to the tools matched by the pattern.
